resolved_findings.finding: RAW_READY and stdin ACK exchange were locked, but RAW_CLEARED and WAIT_SELECTED_GPU could print concurrently from the other lane. With the actual two threads and unbuffered remote stdout, print payload/newline writes could corrupt the receiver line-framed JSON.
resolved_findings.fix_by_parent: Added the same exchange lock around the two previously unlocked lane print sites. No evaluator, model, running source or transport format change.
resolved_findings.resolution: AST ancestry confirms all three lane stdout print calls at lines56,81,91 are inside with exchange; the exact ACK check and child write remain in that same serialized exchange. Controller completion is emitted only after both futures finish.

Restoration uses the dedicated best_official_arrays_restore_missing49.npz name and checks remote bytes/SHA. It does not recreate or overwrite the cleared producer best_official_arrays.npz name.

The restored input is retained between native and full. After full SSH exit0,controller completion,196 unique archived/cleared records, the only restored-copy cleanup checks the exact four recorded names, normal-root containment and bytes/SHA before unlink. Original local selected arrays and all best weights remain retained.

Full extraction builds all seven sets of four CPU feature banks first, preserving each fixed query/gallery reference. It checks weights/versions, copies residual scales to CPU, deletes model and empties the CUDA cache before any per-condition CPU metric/archive loop.
The source reports actual cuda_allocated_bytes after deletion; it does not assert or claim an unmeasured zero. No further model/NN forward occurs during distance generation, metric audit or transfer.

Each worker creates one condition raw.npz, asserts exactly one matching own raw file, waits for its exact archive ACK, rechecks bytes/SHA, removes only that raw file and verifies none remain before proceeding.
Two lanes can therefore have at most two live remote raw NPZ overall, one per worker. Per-condition metadata and metric summaries remain, but49 raw matrices are not accumulated on remote storage.

Actual dimensional arithmetic: one RGBNT100 condition has235298000 uncompressed matrix bytes across four float32 states;49 such conditions would11529602000 bytes per control. Compression and final D capacity are not established by this arithmetic.

The two lanes serialize RAW_READY emission, exactly one stdin readline, matching job/condition/file ACK verification and forwarding to that same child within exchange. The job field is removed only after the controller match, preserving the worker ACK schema.

Every lane stdout print now shares exchange. RAW_CLEARED and wait notices cannot interleave a JSON frame or consume another lane ACK. Main controller completion occurs after both lane futures complete.

On Windows copy_verified enforces a path relative to the dedicated remote root, a new local destination, successful scp, byte count and SHA. Only after it returns does the receiver write the ARCHIVED ACK.

Workers recheck and unlink their own exact raw file only after the verified ACK. Remote and local sets separately require ready/cleared uniqueness and matching counts, and successful child/controller exit precedes terminal receipts.

LANES binds frequency to physicalGPU2 and axis to physicalGPU3 on host2026. Two ThreadPoolExecutor workers each run MSVR310 then RGBNT100 serially and await their child exit before starting the next control; at most two NN children can run.
The reused check_limits queries only GPU index and memory.used, waits240 seconds when occupied and does not query, set or gate temperature or power. Its older filename does not imply thermal control.

Each evaluator child uses start_new_session=True and verifies its process-group ID equals child.pid. The existing finally pattern kills only that own child process group when still alive, awaits it and records the true exit code. No unrelated PID, old controller or global process kill is used.

The unchanged original50-plus-additional50,benchmark-selected best and single seed remain explicit. Native/source acceptance does not guarantee+2 improvement, multiseed acceptance, causality, calibrated contribution or information-theoretic synergy.

Disjoint-source cases explicitly report their distance range/deviation from2 and cross_source_identity_comparison_not_established. All12 are still evaluated and are not described as solved by rounding/ties.

Repeated query rows across conditions are explicitly not independent samples. Existing RGBNT201 narrow results are reused as prior completed evidence; this new four-control evaluator covers only the remaining two datasets.
